How it Works

The graph holds the record. The manual holds the judgment.

Operational Graph

The full organizational record across your operations.

Every message, meeting, deal update, and workflow event — organized into entities, relationships, timelines, and dependencies. A living source of truth of how work connects and changes over time.

Knowledge Manual

The evolving understanding of what currently matters.

Your priorities, open loops, relationship context, SOPs, and operating principles — captured as you work, updated as things change. Explicitly editable, automatically maintained. This is where judgment lives.

Autonomous Agents

Create automatic agents to orchestrate across Gmail, Slack, CRM, and 20+ tools—triggered by events or schedules.

Browser Control

Dex acts directly in your browser to navigate tabs, fill forms, and complete work where the context already lives.

Bring Your Context Anywhere

Use Dex's SDK and MCP to bring your operational context into any agent, tool, or workflow.

Across your favorite apps

Dex connects with power apps, acting across tabs to eliminate context switching.

Proactive. Self-improving. Always on.

Dex learns from your corrections, approvals, edits, and repeated patterns. The more you use it, the sharper it gets.

Always running

Dreamer Agent

Reasons 24/7 over new data. Maintains your knowledge base, spots emerging patterns, keeps your operational context current — even when you're away.

Weekly output

Skill Builder Agent

Generates custom automations and skill suggestions each week, tailored to your repeated workflows to continuously optimize your setup.

Bigger than agent memory.Retrieval surfaces facts. Execution requires reasoning across past precedent, relationships, and context to inform judgment in the next moment.

Your second brain. For work that used to slip through the cracks.

Before every meeting, Dex pulls your full history — emails, past calls, open commitments. Afterwards, automatically send follow-ups using call notes, and writing tone.
